The Mage Guilds are the Amurite Aristocracy. In most nations Royal Guards are drawn from the sons of the rich noble houses that own most of the country. The Amurites have no hereditary nobility. A few magic bloodlines may dominate, but it is illegal for those born of such lineages to ever learn who their parents are. Anyone with innate magical talent is raised by the guild, indoctrinated to believe that their own guild is the only family that deserves their loyalty. All the guilds teach their adepts to serve the nation as a whole, but most also instill a deep suspicion as to the motives of their rival guilds. Any Amurite that could be called an aristocrat must have arcane potential, and would have been trained as an adept as a child whether or not he ever advanced to become a Wizard or Archmage. Those with true talent prefer the more honorable path of a cloistered wizard, but many who would be considered gifted mages in other lands still fail the Amurite's rigorous Trials. These must find some other way to serve their Guild, and to protect their nation from less scrupulous sorcerers.

Arcane Guards require the Aristocracy civic to build, and will leave you if you change civics-so don't bother building them if you plan to change government civics soon. They are very nice units if you meet the requirements, however, as they have the ability to learn any Mage-level spell and have no level requiements. Like normal Royal Guards, they can protect whole stacks against enemies with the Marksman promotion. They also start with the ability to cast Ring of Warding, to protect cities from enemy summons.

Out of a darkened shadow door[NEWLINE]Stepped a beast of unbridled horror[NEWLINE]Cloven hooves, arms of an ape[NEWLINE]Black hair, sharp horns and eyes of hate[NEWLINE]It dragged chains like a giant tail[NEWLINE]It held a hammer, hooks and nails[NEWLINE]The thing reached out and at its touch[NEWLINE]My heart collapsed, my soul was crushed[NEWLINE]It held the chains so I could see[NEWLINE]In a haunting voice it spoke to me[NEWLINE]"for pain you cause there is a price"[NEWLINE]"you pay it in the afterlife"[NEWLINE]and then the creatures work began[NEWLINE]nails in my face, hooks in my hands[NEWLINE]pierced my skin and tore my flesh[NEWLINE]Agony from which there is no rest[PARAGRAPH:3]A Balor is a True Demon, a being of great power created directly by the gods, not the result of Hell corrupting a mortal soul into a demon of the more common sort. Few mortals have any hope of ever matching the strength of even the weakest Balor, although rare exceptions may rise to the rank of Demon Lord and rule over Balors of their own. Every Balor began as an angel in the service of a god, and either followed his master's path towards corruption or rebelled to fall on his own. All of the evil gods have Balors in their service, but most serve only Agares. The King of Hope has never created a single angel or demon, but has seduced many legions of true angels to abandon Good or Neutral gods and enter his employ.

Balors combine the powers of a [LINK=UNIT_PRIEST_OF_THE_VEIL]Ritualist[\\LINK] with strong melee combat abilities and affinities.[NEWLINE]They be trained by the Infernals, or summoned by any unit with [LINK=PROMOTION_ENTROPY3]Entropy III[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENTROPY]Entropy III[\\LINK][NEWLINE]As True Demons, [LINK=PROMOTION_BOUND_BY_COMPACT]The Compact[\\LINK] forbids Balors to enter any portion of Erebus that is not already exceedingly corrupt. Those temporarily summoned by mortals can get around this limitation. [NEWLINE]There are Balors in the service of every evil god. Most were originally Angels of that god, but every Balor of Agares was originally an angel of a good of neutral god. Most Balors keep their original affinities.

Runewyns are [LINK=PROMOTION_MAGIC_IMMUNE]Magic Immune[\\LINK], [LINK=PROMOTION_WINGED]Winged[\\LINK] [LINK=PROMOTION_ANGEL]Angels[\\LINK] that can be summoned with [LINK=PROMOTION_FORCE3]Force III[\\LINK] or upgraded from [LINK=CIVILIZATION_MERCURIAN]Mercurian[\\LINK] [LINK=UNIT_ANGEL]Angels[\\LINK]. Either way, they receive a free promotion pick for every source of [LINK=BONUS_MANA_FORCE]Force mana[\\LINK] their owners control. Runewyns specialize in combatting magic. They are the only summon thay can bypass the defenses of a [LINK=BUILDING_RING_OF_WARDING]Ring of Warding[\\LINK]. Even when they loose the fight, they still destroy this and every other magically-maintained building in any city they attack. They also remove all of the spell sphere promotions and all magical effects from the units they attack (except [LINK=PROMOTION_AVATAR]Avatars[\\LINK]). Runewyns are strong against [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_DISCIPLE]Disciple units[\\LINK] and very strong against [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK], targeting them in stacks of stronger units (except in cities).

Rather than upgrading to an ordinary Mage, Amurite Adepts with enough experience may become Wizards. A Wizard has all of the abilities of a Mage, but is slightly stronger in combat and begins with a Spell Staff and an extra free promotion pick for every source of Metamagic Mana its owner controls. An Adept still has to be at least 3rd level before it can be upgraded to a Wizard.

These fell beasts begin as ordinary animals, which [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]The Ashen Veil[\\LINK] corrupts and empowers through an unholy ritual requiring the sacrifice of many souls upon a [LINK=BUILDING_TEMPLE_OF_THE_VEIL]Demon's Altar. [\\LINK] They have limited duration; the Entropy that empowers them will consume them too, unless they continue devouring souls through either combat or [LINK=SPELL_BEAST_FEAST]further sacrifices[\\LINK], or the Entropy that empowers them will consume them too. Beasts of Agares are especially skilled at hunting down the holy warriors of other religions, especially Paladins.

The woods around the Well of Shadows is protected by the Widdershins Curse, confounding the sense of direction of all who wander near. A [LINK=PROMOTION_DEASIL_CHARM]Deasil Charm[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_SHADOWWALK]Shadowwalk[\\LINK] render one immune.
